original_test_intent: Validate power telemetry for GB HSC1 through HSC10 against the approved electrical specification across complete IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web views, with each channel bound to its physical HSC and NVGPU load domain.
original_method: The power/GPU owner defines ten exact names and maps every HSC to board location, input rail/feed, protected output/load and NVGPU identity; passive automation collects readings, states and supporting electrical context without changing load or power state.
manual_activity: The HSC/power/GPU owner approves the ten-channel electrical topology, NVGPU load bindings, units/scaling and condition-specific limits, then reviews all views. Fan evidence and inferred load manipulation are excluded.
required_inputs: Exact PWR_GB_HSC1 through PWR_GB_HSC10 names and populated channel count
GB/HSC board revision and per-index physical location
Per-HSC input rail/feed, protected output/load and NVGPU serial/UUID/BDF association
Meaning of power value, units, scale, sign, aggregation window, refresh and unavailable state
Voltage/current/power-good/fault context and consistency rule without deriving unapproved verdicts
Ranges by idle/load/power/cooling condition plus tolerance and threshold behavior
SDR entity/description and Sensor List/Web mapping with same-target revisions
Secret-safe collectors and independent power/GPU/BMC recovery
safety_requirements: Bind exact row 1887 and exclude the duplicate lower-fan workflow
Resolve ten exact members rather than querying a literal tilde expression
Treat `(NVGPU)` as annotation, not shell syntax or permission to run a GPU workload
Bind each channel to a physical switch, rail and stable GPU/load identity
Do not alter load, GPU driver, HSC state, power, thresholds, BMC or logs
Stop on identity mismatch, invalid/stale power, power-good/fault change, thermal event or incomplete channel set
agent_execution_scope: Verify source/variant, duplicate isolation and ten-name expansion
Verify HSC/rail/load/NVGPU topology and same-target identity read-only
Collect complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List, ten exact records and BMC Web
Compare value/state/freshness with passive voltage/current/power-good/GPU/SEL context
Perform no fan substitution, workload, driver reload, power control, mutation, retry or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve ten-channel HSC electrical and NVGPU load-domain map
Define power quantity, scale, aggregation and correlation criteria
Provide condition-specific ranges, tolerances and fault-state rules
Review all ten channels and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Incomplete: `PWR_GB_HSC1~10` is not one proven sensor name; only OOB plus truncated SDR is offered, credentials are exposed and IB/Sensor List/Web are absent. `(NVGPU)` is annotation only.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Resolve ten owner-approved names and collect complete secret-safe IB/OOB SDR/Sensor List plus Web with passive HSC rail, load and NVGPU identity context.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: HSC1–HSC10, all source views and 3/3-minute estimates remain; LOWER_FAN1–5_R is excluded.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES TEN-CHANNEL HSC ELECTRICAL MAP AND POWER SEMANTICS
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a ten-row channel matrix tying exact sensor identity to HSC location, source rail, protected load, GPU identity, power unit/scale and approved operating envelope, then reconcile complete views.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes electrical topology and measurement semantics explicit instead of treating ten similarly named values as interchangeable.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A fan Web row or aggregate GPU power reading cannot substitute for per-HSC input/output-domain power telemetry.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: HSC numbering may follow board routing rather than GPU numbering, and averaged or signed power data can be misread without scale/window semantics; a wrong binding can conceal an overloaded switch.

project_override_considerations: Shared, redundant or unused HSC channels require owner-defined aggregation and not-present rules; voltage multiplied by current is only supporting context unless the SPEC approves that comparison.
expected_evidence: Power quantity, units, scale, aggregation, freshness and limit contract
Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List plus ten exact results
BMC Web, same-target proof, passive SEL/platform logs, statuses and hashes

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Row 1887 consistently targets ten GB HSC power channels; topology and measurement semantics are project inputs. The same-code lower-fan row is a separate source identity.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The passive ten-channel comparison is identifiable once the owner supplies the electrical/NVGPU map and criteria under ED-35/36.

review_improvement: Adds per-channel electrical topology, GPU load-domain binding and measurement-window semantics while explicitly rejecting the executable interpretation of `(NVGPU)`.
independent_technical_reasoning: A hot-swap controller power channel may represent input, protected output, an averaged estimate or a board-specific aggregate. Because HSC index and GPU index need not align, both the electrical path and measurement definition must be proven before a ten-channel balance or limit comparison is meaningful.
